protocol.question: Within original strict-loss pairs, how much does pinned F change ranking through pinned physical V, immediate reward, and terminal mask separately?
protocol.denominator: Exactly original a2-pairs original_strict_error: sign(delta G) nonzero and sign(delta saved Qpred) opposite, tolerance1e-6. Fixed across all stages; not all G-improved pairs.
stages: physical-only: original rpred + float32(.99*true pinned V)
then realReward: real reward + float32(.99*true pinned V)
then terminal: real reward alone if done
protocol.floating: Old scoring multiplies gamma*V in torch.float32, then adds reward tensor (float64 if any predicted candidate nonterminal; float32 for all-terminal batch). Oracle converts float32 product to Python float before adding real reward. Preserve both actual contracts and report reconstruction/rounding residuals; no float64 gamma*V substitution.
protocol.transition: Correction=wrong->correct, reverse=correct->wrong relative to fixed realized G. Physical reverse is structurally0 on an initially-wrong denominator; ties tracked separately. Later reverse can undo earlier correction.
protocol.interpretation: Physical-only changes the oracle-pinned last-frame V, not pure CV position error: all true next human position/velocity fields with pinned IDs affect encoder output. These are ordered algebraic diagnostic replacements, not additive navigation-cause fractions.
protocol.GO: Reconstruction matches archived P/F within reported floating precision: publish descriptive subdivision only.
protocol.KILL: Failed reconstruction: invalidate this subdivision; do not infer mechanism or launch new experiments.
protocol.budget: One CPU streaming pass over existing branch files; no new model invocation, GPU, rollout, optimizer or selection.
